declared: 2026-09-13, after calibration on the Stage 2 continuity clips, before any feature of tests/corpus/outro-context.json was computed
applies: only to a transcript whose entire content is a known outro artifact
feature: share of energy-envelope modulation power in 2-8 Hz over 0.5-25 Hz, envelope sampled every 10 ms
rule: reject when the window is shorter than 1.0 s; otherwise reject only when the modulation share is below the threshold

rejectedFeatures.pitchGlide: 0.0 on quiet speech, because quiet frames fall under the voicing threshold
rejectedFeatures.wordProbabilityMean: hallucinations 0.90-0.92 overlap an interjection at 0.409 and speech near 0.97

passCriteria: on the frozen set: every spoken-thanks clip retained, every music-only outro hallucination rejected

secondMethod.declared: 2026-09-13, after the envelope-modulation rule failed on the frozen set, calibrated only on the Stage 2 continuity clips, before any VAD result on tests/corpus/outro-context.json was computed
secondMethod.feature: voiced seconds measured by the extension's own VAD stages: SpeechGain, Silero V5 with 64 samples of context, frames at probability >= 0.30
secondMethod.rule: keep an outro-artifact transcript only when voiced seconds >= minVoicedSeconds; otherwise reject

speechClipsVoicedSeconds.maxShortClipsExcluded: clips under 1 s carry no 15-mora phrase
